prose.subject: Invoice INV-24787 & New Payout Account Details
prose.body:
Dear Priya,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to provide you with our updated payment information for upcoming settlements between Netherby Media and Greywater Robotics.

Recently, we added a new payout account to our treasury structure. Please ensure that future transfers are directed to the address 0x725b7f7120326c8b9fc8c2753561947f77db564f. We have successfully linked this account to our verified domain, netherby-media.example, to facilitate smoother verification processes on your end.

Attached to this email, please find invoice INV-24787 for the amount of 2437.10 USDC. This invoice covers the services rendered during the last billing cycle. Kindly review the attached document and process the payment at your earliest convenience. If you require any additional documentation or have questions regarding the account update, please do not hesitate to reach out.

Thank you for your continued partnership.

Best regards,

Sofia Lindqvist
Netherby Media
